what: schema elements the text2cypher arm named that the graph does not have
queries: MATCH (c:ConfigurationItem {name:'database'})-[:SUPPORTS*1..2]-(t:Team)\nRETURN DISTINCT t.name AS team_name LIMIT 60

MATCH (i:Incident)-[:RAISED_BY]->(p:Person {name: 'Complaints'})<-[:SAID]-(s:KnowledgeArticle)
   RETURN s.content AS complaint
   ORDER BY SIZE(s.content) DESC
   LIMIT 10

MATCH (i:Incident)-[:RAISED_BY]->(r:Person),
      (w:ConfigurationItem {name:'working_hours_flag'})
WHERE i.raised_date < w.end_of_working_hours_time AND i.raised_date >= w.start_of_working_hours_time - duration('P1M')
RETURN i.number AS incident_number
LIMIT 60

MATCH (i:Incident)-[:RAISED_BY|ASSIGNED_TO]-(p:Person), 
      (p)-[:SAID|REPEATED*1..3]-(s:Statement)
WHERE s.text CONTAINS 'deploy' OR s.text CONTAINS 'config change'
RETURN DISTINCT i.number AS incidentNumber, s.text AS statementText
LIMIT 60
MATCH (t:Incident {number: 'pg0071'})-[:AFFECTS]->(ci:ConfigurationItem)\nOPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:RESOLVES_TO]->(r:KnowledgeArticle)\nRETURN r.number AS resolutionNotes LIMIT 1
